originalText: Keep the existing healthy 10000 ms group bound and production retry/cutover budgets. A fully spent healthy bound is red. Validate any port-provided retry duration and schedule it on the release owner's existing clock without a tight loop or deadline conversion across clocks.
replacementText: Keep the existing healthy 10000 ms group bound and production retry/cutover budgets. A fully spent healthy bound is red. Retain canonical host-held observation debt at the existing fixed PARTICIPANT_CUTOVER_BOUND.RECOVERY_RETRY_MS cadence on the release owner clock. This owner must never read, coerce, validate, compare, add or schedule from status.retryAfterMs; prove that field observationally inert, including throwing accessors and hostile values. The unchanged raft-rs runtime remains sole owner of the reconstruction not-before gate and core-entry permission.
reason: Independent design review rejected consuming port-provided durations because safe integers can overflow platform timers or now+delay. Fixed existing cadence avoids a second duration-policy owner. The original wording is superseded explicitly; absence of consumption does not satisfy the old validation/scheduling requirement.
correction: The sentence in design-approved.md claiming the original duration-validation constraint is satisfied by making the field inert is superseded by this record. Technical design approval supports the replacement behavior, not that interpretation of the original text.
decisionOwner: root integrating the authorized continuation; independent technical review subagent:/root/tx1_deletion_design_vet

sealedAcceptanceUnchanged.statement: When an initialized hosted partition loses its raft-rs host during an existing-origin participant release, the registered participant release recovery owner retains one bounded continuation while the canonical port status says the group is held by host recovery. The existing raft-rs runtime owner reconstructs and replays the group; only a later fresh observation of an actual current leader may enter the unchanged current origin, build, membership, generation, drain, census and resume release path. A healthy follower remains event-driven, recovery stays single-flight and bounded, and replacement or shutdown cannot reopen stale service admission.

history: Original quest, design artifacts and append-only log retained unchanged. The probe, statement, epic, five receipts and healthy budgets are neither weakened nor reinterpreted.
